en: This is an image of a postage stamp commemorating the 500th anniversary of the University of Freiburg (Universität Freiburg), established in 1457 and celebrating in 1957. The stamp features an illustration of a medieval academic scene, likely a lecture, with a professor and several students. The colors are predominantly teal, red, and black, and the value of the stamp is 10. The text is in German.
